digest.component_or_area: review-bot deployment and ticket store convergence
propositions: The review-bot's persistent tickets clone on EBS-backed external volume is not refreshed on redeploy because the Dockerfile entrypoint clones only when .git is absent, preserving divergent history across redeployments.

The ensure-tickets script must implement clone self-convergence after fetching with explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets, using reconverge for compatible stores and a narrow pre-epoch-to-epoch adoption path when safe preconditions are met.
The autodeploy.sh BOT_PATHS must include infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh so that future ensure-script changes trigger automatic redeployment and reach the box without manual bootstrap.
Convergence failures must remain best-effort and preserve best-effort vote safety, never undoing already-cast Gerrit votes or wedging artifact emission even if store writes fail.

Pre-epoch local clones whose tips are ancestors of a readable prior remote may adopt the pinned fetched epoch-bearing commit; all other local-ahead, diverged, missing-ref, or corrupt states must refuse adoption, preserve the exact local tip, warn, and require operator intervention.
The ensure script must execute outside the PAT credential block to enable convergence when REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT is unset, and must leave no merge, stash, or rebase state after any convergence path.
